profile.headline: Software Engineer LMTS
profile.jobTitle: Security Software Engineer Lead Member of Technical Staff

positions.title: Security Software Engineer Lead Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
* Working as a technical Lead on Security Center: https://www.salesforce.com/products/platform/products/security-center/
* Worked as the Technical Lead on infrastructure security projects concerning centralized secret services (vaults), Key management system, PKI, and hardware security modules (HSMs).
* Hands-on experience with SafeNet/Thales HSM, PKCS#11, google cloud platform (gcp) hsm, key signing-ceremony, Puppet, Git/Perforce, Docker, Java, Python, Golang, OpenSSL
* Designed and implementation of internal PKI Systems.

positions.title: Lead Security PKI Developer
positions.description:
Developed PKI applications to generate, retrieve and managed x.509 credentials to inter-operate with the following authentication interface using C++, JAVA, OpenSSL, Perl, PHP:

* Virtual smart card (TPM), One time passcode (OTP), Smart Card PKCS#11, OATH Token, Venafi interface

Oversees PKI operations, maintenance and debug.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed scientific applications using Java, C++, Hibernate, and Satellite Toolkit to support math and science to kids for both the MoonKAM Grail and EarthKAM projects at Sally Ride Science.  

Wrote C++ application to control the camera on the International Space Station(ISS) to take photo of the earth based on ephemeris data that was generated.

Re-wrote the genesis (payload), orbit software.

Deployed augmented reality applications to support pattern recognition for 3D.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Developed mail transfer agent (MTA) to support DKIM/Domain keys using JAVA Security, C, OpenSSL, Mozilla NSS, PHP

positions.title: Programmer Analyst III
positions.description: Redesign and developed Grid portal PKI and authorization component from the ground up using GridSphere (open source Java JSR 168 portal).

positions.title: Certificate Authority Developer
positions.description: Design and developed the NASA Information Power Grid PKI systems/tools to support mutual authentication with the Globus Grid Security Infrastructure (GSI).

honors.title: NASA Group Achievement Award
honors.description: Outstanding performance in providing the MoonKAM, an exceptional Education and Public Outreach resource onboard the GRAIL spacecraft, to NASA at an affordable cost.

honors.title: NASA Ames Group Achievement Award
honors.description: To the Information Power Grid Group for the successful implementation of the Information Power Grid (IPG)
